sources.snippet: RoBERTuito is a pre-trained language model for user-generated content in Spanish, trained following RoBERTa guidelines on 500 million tweets. RoBERTuito comes in 3 flavors: cased, uncased, and uncased+deaccented.

sources.title: Paper page - RoBERTuito: a pre-trained language model for social media ...
sources.snippet: In this work, we present Ro BERT uito, a pre-trained language model for user-generated text in Spanish, trained on over 500 million tweets. Experiments on a benchmark of tasks involving user-generated text showed that Ro BERT uito outperformed other pre-trained language model s in Spanish.
